title: Ascension Shriek
description: A wet FM riser that hangs high in the register, its FM index and harmonicity boiling while a pitch envelope and accelerating glide drag each note steeply upward into a noise-flecked scream. Over 16 cycles the band-pass sweep climbs, the glide steepens, and noise blooms before the loop resets.
code:
setcpm(124/4)
stack(
  note("<a4 c5 <e5 a5>>/2").s("sine")
    .fm(sine.slow(13).range(3, 16)).fmh("<1 2 1.5 3>/4")
    .penv(saw.slow(32).range(8, 30)).pattack(0.001).pdecay(sine.slow(16).range(0.4, 0.12))
    .accelerate(saw.slow(16).range(0.3, 2.5))
    .vib("<5 7 11>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(7).range(0.3, 1.8))
    .noise(sine.slow(24).range(0.02, 0.3))
    .bpf(saw.slow(16).range(700, 6500)).resonance(sine.slow(11).range(8, 18))
    .attack(0.01).decay(0.3).sustain(0.6).release(0.2)
    .pan(sine.slow(9).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .off(1/6, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3).speed(1.5))
    .delay("0.6:0.375:0.72").room(0.8).gain(0.7)
)
